title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund operation
content:
## Use and effect

Virtual Compute — Execute the customer's own cash refund against the original payment after the desk hands over the numerical assessment. This returns funds to the original ACH destination represented by the source payment and records the positive receivable delta. The posted receipt confirms the cash disposition synchronously; only the customer invokes this action.

## Invocation

refund_compute_payment_f0565a85 must first be unlocked (unlock) and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameter compute_holding_id

`compute_holding_id`: Id class — The compute contract reference for immediate refund copied from find_compute_holdings or find_compute_events.

## Parameter customer_id

`customer_id`: Id class — Identifier of the customer copied from find_customers.

## Parameter compute_event_id

`compute_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the existing pending customer refund request copied from find_compute_events; identical to request_id.

## Parameter source_event_id

`source_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the original posted payment named by that request, copied from find_compute_events.

## Parameter request_id

`request_id`: Id class — Identifier of the existing pending customer refund request copied from find_compute_events; identical to compute_event_id.

## Parameter related_event_id

`related_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the approved eligible refund assessment for this request and original payment, copied from the preceding successful assessment receipt or find_compute_events.

## Parameter amount

`amount`: Fixed-format class — The positive financial amount in units of USD to two decimals, supplied as a decimal number already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion; stored to two decimals, with no empty value.

## Successful receipt

The successful string receipt identifies the newly recorded immediate refund by its new business event reference and confirms its posted registration and the business effect described above.
